sources.label: Minea home
sources.claim: Minea positions itself as an ad-spy tool for e-commerce and dropshipping: a database of top-performing shops and ads to find winning products, track trends, and monitor competitors.

sources.label: Minea pricing
sources.claim: Minea lists Starter at $49/month, Premium at $99/month, and Business at $199/month on monthly billing, with lower per-month rates when paid quarterly.
